messages:
Mina: Quick idea — show a compact per-invoice token subtotal inline but hide detailed line-item breakdowns by default for non-finance roles. Mock: https://img.redwood/mock/role-visibility.png
Carlos: Role-based visibility makes sense for compliance. For org views we can surface a small 'Show breakdown' affordance for permitted users; others see 'Details restricted' with an action to request access.
Jesse: Backend callout: add a query param `include_breakdowns_for_roles=true` and enforce RBAC server-side. CSV/JSON exports should include a header column `breakdown_visible` so downstream consumers know whether rows are full or redacted.
Priyanka: Accessibility: the toggle must be a real <button> with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. If details are restricted, use `aria-describedby` pointing to a short accessible explanation. Use `aria-live` when content loads so screenreaders announce newly injected breakdown content.
bot-a11y: A11y checklist: keyboard operable, focus order preserved, announce access denied vs content loaded, contrast and focus ring checks, tooltip text reachable via keyboard.
Mina: UX copy: inline subtotal shows "2,312 tokens" as a link/button for allowed roles; for restricted roles show "2,312 tokens · details restricted" and a small request-access CTA that opens a modal pre-filled with invoice id.
Carlos: Security note: log an audit event whenever a user expands a previously restricted breakdown. Also rate-limit expansion attempts from the same actor.
Jesse: Rough estimates: frontend (visibility toggle, request modal, tooltips) ~2 dev days; backend (RBAC checks, export flag, audit events) ~2 dev days; QA + docs + A11y review ~1 day.
Priyanka: Copy nit: keep primary unit label as "tokens" in UI; export may accept `units=compute_units` param — map in docs with exact conversion so finance tools stay deterministic.
Mina: Acceptance criteria for PR: role-aware show/hide implemented, toggle is keyboard-accessible with aria attributes, export param and CSV header added, audit events produced on access, request-access flow wired, updated docs and a11y checklist. I'll upload the Figma screens and open the PR when ready.
Carlos: Assigning: @mina frontend, @jesse backend, @priyanka a11y review. :white_check_mark:
